title.value: Analysis and Detection of Information Types of Open Source Software Issue Discussions
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the document as "Analysis and Detection of Information Types of Open Source Software Issue Discussions."
title.quote: Analysis and Detection of Information Types of Open Source Software Issue Discussions

analysis.description: The paper presents a study aimed at identifying information types in Open Source Software (OSS) issue discussion threads. It utilizes a labeled corpus derived from issues in GitHub projects and evaluates supervised classification techniques to detect information types. The research intends to improve information retrieval from discussion threads to support various OSS stakeholders.

type.justification: The paper conducts empirical research using content analysis and supervised classification techniques on real-world data from GitHub projects.
type.quote: Through qualitative content analysis of 15 complex issue threads across three projects hosted on GitHub, we uncovered 16 information types and created a labeled corpus containing 4656 sentences.

name.justification: The research focuses on issue discussions in software engineering, specifically within open source software development.
name.quote: Our work is closely related to previous studies that focused on (1) the role of ITSs in software engineering activities and (2) classification of software-related texts.

name.justification: The research specifically analyzes open source software issue discussions.
name.quote: For Open Source Software (OSS) projects in particular, ITSs (e.g. the Issues feature of GitHub) are critical in engaging various stakeholders throughout the project life-cycle.

name.justification: Supervised text classification techniques are employed to identify the information types of sentences in OSS issue threads.
name.quote: We then evaluated the effectiveness of using supervised methods to automatically identify those information types in the issue comments.

name.justification: The research includes evaluations using machine learning classification techniques like Random Forest and Logistic Regression.
name.quote: Logistic Regression can yield satisfactory performance using textual features for certain information types, while falling short on others.

name.justification: The study involves text analysis and categorization, involving NLP techniques to classify issue discussion content.
name.quote: The use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques is highlighted in analyzing and summarizing software-related texts.

name.justification: The Random Forest model was specifically mentioned as being used in the evaluations within the study.
name.quote: Random Forest can effectively detect most sentence types using conversational features such as the sentence length and its position.
